# wso2is_webhook (Resource)

Manages a webhook (WSO2 IS 7.2 and later). The server sends identity events to the webhook as signed HTTP POST requests. Events include logins, sessions, changes to user accounts, registrations, tokens and credential updates. To import, use the webhook ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_webhook" "audit" {
  name     = "Audit events"
  endpoint = "https://hooks.example.com/wso2is"
  secret   = var.webhook_secret
  channels = [
    "https://schemas.identity.wso2.org/events/login",
    "https://schemas.identity.wso2.org/events/user",
  ]
}

variable "webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channels` (Set of String) Channel URIs to subscribe to, for example `https://schemas.identity.wso2.org/events/login`, `.../session`, `.../user`, `.../registration`, `.../token`, `.../credential`.
- `endpoint` (String) HTTPS URL events are posted to.
- `name` (String) Webhook name.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether events are sent. The default is `true`.
- `event_profile` (String) Event profile name. The default is `WSO2`.
- `event_profile_uri` (String) Event profile URI. The default is `https://schemas.identity.wso2.org/events`.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The secret that the server uses to sign each payload (`X-WSO2-Event-Signature`). The server never returns it, so the provider cannot notice changes made outside Terraform.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Webhook ID.
- `status` (String) The webhook's status on the server: `ACTIVE`, `PARTIALLY_ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `PARTIALLY_INACTIVE`. A partial status means that some channel subscriptions failed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_webhook.audit <webhook_id>
```
